description: Two workers on a flat rooftop at dusk installing a solar water heater - evacuated tube collector array plus tank, with city lights visible in the background. Striking dusk-lit installation shot.
Paving bricks lifted next to a house wall to expose a poly pipe joint, muddy water pooled in the hole, worker's hands and tools (tape measure, hammer, pliers, bucket) around the excavation.
Worker in blue overalls bent over checking a new wall-mounted basin and chrome tap installed on a wooden vanity cabinet, in a modern grey-tiled bathroom. Clean finished-bathroom install shot.
Close-up of a geyser heating element pulled out and held in hand, visible scale/mineral buildup on the coil, a multimeter/clamp meter and tools in the background. Diagnostic/element-replacement shot.
Close-up of a repair coupling/clamp fitted on a pipe underneath lifted paving bricks, in a small dug-out cavity near a wall.
Toilet cistern open showing the fill valve mechanism being installed/adjusted, worker in a beanie kneeling beside it, buckets on the tiled floor nearby.
Outdoor pipes running down a brick house wall, water pooling/flooding on the lawn nearby with a pipe stub sticking up out of the waterlogged ground. Drainage/waterlogging issue in a yard.
A valve/fitting exposed in a muddy dug-out hole under lifted paving bricks, murky water pooled around it, roots and rebar visible in the mud.
Outdoor water meter and pressure control valve installation against a house wall, copper pipework bent into shape, an old brass tap beside it, drain grate on the ground nearby.
Worn toilet + tile floor, plain documentation shot.
Mid-repair shot: bathroom sink with tap handles and valve stem parts disassembled and laid out on the basin edge, wrench visible.
Pressure-test setup: gauge (kPa/bar), red ball valve and air line connected to an outdoor standpipe near a storm drain.
Outdoor drain/manhole set in brick paving, full of standing murky water, old exposed piping and tap nearby.
Outdoor vertical pipe running down a wall next to a concrete drain grate, dug-up dirt patch beside it.
Geyser install in a roof/attic space, pipework and fittings being connected up among the roof trusses.
Open toilet cistern showing the internal fill valve mechanism, red valve top, orange float ball.
Geyser installed in a roof/attic space among the trusses and insulation, copper pipework with a visible soldered joint.
JoJo water storage tank installation against a house wall, with a pressure pump, ball valves and piping connected at the base.
